data.description: Direct Beach Access | Panoramic Sea Views | Ultra-Luxury
data.long_description:
Como Residences is a luxury development by Nakheel Properties. The stunning 75-storey tower, exuding unrivalled elegance and splendour, will take the shape of an organic sea shell pointing towards the sky. Highlights of the complex include a series of vertical lakes and a rooftop landscape pool, which will be located on the 71st floor. There is also a 360-degree rooftop observation deck, which has become the highest observation deck at Palm Jumeirah. The project offers a total of 76 limited edition residences, namely 2-6 bedroom apartments, 7-bedroom duplexes and one impressive 5-bedroom duplex penthouse.

The complex features outdoor lounges and dining areas. Some apartments include a private swimming pool.
Key features include branded kitchen appliances, high ceilings in living rooms, floor-to-ceiling insulated windows and smart home features.

Residents are provided with 3 to 7 car parking spaces, depending on property type, and the exclusive penthouse has 10 designated car spaces.With direct access to Crescent Road, residents will be able to travel easily from mainland Dubai. As a result, travelling time to Dubai International Airport will not exceed 25 minutes by car. Como Residences by Nakheel Properties is a super luxury development in the centre of the Palm Jumeirah trunk.

Finance is available on this property through Premier Property Finance. Call us on +97143233609 for a free consultation.
